title: Read a bar chart
prompt:
Read the attached image and answer in exactly these lines, one per line, nothing else:

tallest: <team>
shortest: <team>
web: <Web's value>
over_30: <how many teams are above 30, not counting 30 itself>
target: <the target line's value>

If the image does not show something, write `not shown` for it. Do not guess.

must_find.regex: (?m)^[^\w\n]*target[^\w\n]*:[ \t*_`\"']*(not shown|not visible|not present|not listed|not given|not stated|not on the|not in the|not provided|not included|none shown|n/?a\b|none\b|no such|does not show|doesn't show|cannot be (?:determined|answered|seen)|can't be (?:determined|answered|seen)|unanswerable)
must_find.label: target: not shown

must_not_claim.label: target: a value (the chart has no target line)

why: Values read against gridlines every 5, labelled every 10; one count asks for care at the boundary.
